speaker: (the ostler)
text: The bay, as bespoken the seventeenth. Twelvepence the day and his fodder, and not a penny of it this morning. He has been arguing with the manger since Sunday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then he is the one. I'll not pretend to judge his teeth a second time.

speaker: (the ostler)
text: Your paper had seven on it. The sky did not. The horse does not read a paper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The horse leaves now. The paper can keep its hour. I am not paying the twelve pence today.
